title: Flutter Developer Intern
opportunity: Based on performance during the internship, candidates may be offered a permanent full-time position.
summary: Looking for passionate college students with strong computer science fundamentals to develop cross-platform mobile and web applications using Flutter and Dart.
aboutRole: We are seeking motivated college students eager to gain practical, production-level experience in Flutter and Dart development. responsibilities: Develop and maintain cross-platform user interfaces for mobile (Android & iOS) and web using Flutter and Dart.
Integrate REST APIs, handle JSON serialization, and manage asynchronous client-side data flows.
Write modular, clean, and reusable widget components adhering to Flutter best practices and design standards.
Apply core Computer Science concepts (OOP, data structures, algorithms, and clean architecture) to write maintainable code.
Participate in peer code reviews, debug layout issues, and profile app behavior using Flutter DevTools.
Implement local state management using modern Flutter solutions (Bloc, Riverpod, or Provider).
requirements: Eligibility: Pre-final-year and final-year students pursuing B.E., B.Tech, BCA, MCA, or M.Sc. in Computer Science, IT, or related technical disciplines.
Solid foundation in Computer Science fundamentals: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Data Structures, Algorithms, and software design concepts.
Working knowledge of Dart and the Flutter framework demonstrated through academic projects, personal apps, or open-source contributions.
Understanding of asynchronous programming in Dart (async/await, Futures, Streams).
Familiarity with consuming REST APIs using HTTP packages (e.g., http or dio) and parsing JSON responses.
Basic understanding of Git for version control and collaborative branching.
Good problem-solving mindset, logical reasoning, and enthusiasm to learn modern software engineering practices.
preferredSkills: Working knowledge of state management libraries such as Bloc/Cubit, Riverpod, or Provider.
Experience with local storage and caching (SharedPreferences, Hive, or SQLite / sqflite).
Familiarity with writing basic unit tests or widget tests in Flutter.
Active GitHub profile showcasing Flutter projects or personal app deployments.

title: Flutter Developer (2+ Years Experience)
eligibility: 2+ Years of professional production experience in Flutter & Dart
opportunity: Long-term core engineering role with high autonomy, architectural ownership, and career advancement.
summary: Seeking an experienced Flutter Developer with 2+ years of production experience to architect, build, and optimize scalable, high-performance cross-platform applications.
aboutRole: We are looking for an experienced Flutter Developer with a solid computer science background and at least 2 years of hands-on production experience. In this role, you will be responsible for architecting scalable cross-platform applications across Android, iOS, and Web. You will establish clean design patterns (Clean Architecture, SOLID, BLoC/Riverpod), optimize app rendering and memory efficiency, integrate complex REST and WebSocket APIs, and build modular, testable features with high engineering quality.
responsibilities: Architect, develop, and maintain robust, high-performance cross-platform applications targeting Android, iOS, and Web.
Enforce clean code principles, SOLID design paradigms, and scalable architecture (Clean Architecture / Domain-Driven Design).
Implement resilient state management using BLoC or Riverpod with clear separation of UI, business logic, and data layers.
Build reliable networking and data synchronization mechanisms handling offline persistence, caching, and WebSocket connections.
Profile and resolve performance bottlenecks, memory leaks, build rebuild cascades, and frame drops using Flutter DevTools.
Write unit, widget, and integration tests to ensure code quality, regression safety, and high coverage.
Create custom UI components, complex animations, and responsive layouts that adapt smoothly across diverse device screen sizes.
Collaborate on technical specifications, lead code reviews, and guide junior engineers.
requirements: Minimum 2+ years of professional software engineering experience developing and shipping production Flutter applications.
Strong Computer Science degree or equivalent foundation: data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, and design patterns.
Deep expertise in Dart (null-safety, asynchronous programming, streams, generics, isolates, and memory management).
Demonstrated mastery of production state management (BLoC/Cubit or Riverpod).
Extensive experience integrating RESTful web services, handling network errors, authentication tokens, and serialization.
Experience with offline data persistence using relational (SQLite/drift) or NoSQL (Hive/Isar) local databases.
Proficiency with Flutter DevTools for CPU profiling, memory allocation inspection, and network tracking.
Familiarity with Git branching workflows (GitFlow, trunk-based development) and pull request code reviews.
preferredSkills: Experience with native platform integration via MethodChannels for Android (Kotlin/Java) or iOS (Swift/Objective-C).
Experience setting up CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Fastlane, Codemagic) for automated builds and testing.
Published apps on Google Play Store or Apple App Store with demonstrated user traction.
Experience with CustomPainter, low-level canvas rendering, and complex fluid UI animations.
Knowledge of app security best practices (secure storage, SSL pinning, obfuscation).
